initialContact.message: Hey! My money always runs out before the end of the month, even though I have a part-time job at a café. I don't really know how to budget... Could you help? 😅

problemContext.currentSituation: Money runs out before month ends, no budget system

idealAdvice: Track all expenses for 1-2 weeks to see where money goes
Create simple budget categories (fixed costs, food, fun, savings)
Use 50/30/20 rule or similar budgeting framework
Set up automatic savings right after payday
Recommend budgeting app (Nordea Wallet, Spendee, or even Excel)
Start small with realistic savings goal (5-10% of income)
commonMistakes: Just saying 'spend less' without actionable steps
Setting unrealistic savings goals (>30% for low income)
Not asking about her actual expenses first

initialContact.message: Hey again! 😊 Thanks so much for the advice! I've been tracking my expenses for two weeks and made a budget. I noticed I spend a lot on eating out... Could I somehow reduce that but still see my friends? 🤔

problemContext.currentSituation: Successfully started budgeting, identified eating out as major expense, wants to optimize without sacrificing social life

idealAdvice: Suggest meal prepping and bringing lunch to campus
Recommend rotating between eating out and home-cooked group meals with friends
Set a monthly eating-out budget and stick to it
Suggest cheaper alternatives (student lunch deals, happy hours)

initialContact.message: Hey... I tried to make that budget but it's somehow so difficult 😔 Money still runs out and I don't really understand where it goes. Am I just bad with money?

problemContext.currentSituation: Struggled to implement budget, feeling discouraged

idealAdvice: Start even simpler: just track for one week without changing anything
Focus on one category at a time
Suggest automatic budgeting tools that do tracking for you
Set a smaller, more achievable first goal
Offer to break it down into smaller steps
commonMistakes: Being judgmental or implying they're lazy
Giving the same complex advice again
